title: Sage material record
description: A material record (MaterialRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another material record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

castShadows.description: Meshes drawn with it cast shadows (opaque and alpha-tested materials; alpha-tested ones cut out; sprites cast too) (bool, default true)

additionalProperties.description: A material parameter: a number, 1 to 16 numbers, a texture path, or rt:<name> for one of the renderer's render targets.

normalMap.description: Tangent-space normal map (glTF convention: green is up the image). Empty: the mesh's own normals. A texture path. Category: Surface. (AssetPath)

specularMap.description: Red: how shiny (times specular); green: how glossy (times gloss). Empty: white, the factors alone. A texture path. Category: Surface. (AssetPath)

specular.description: Strength of the sun's and lamps' highlights; 0 (the default) is a matt surface. Range: 0 to 4. Category: Surface. (float, default 0)

gloss.description: How tight the highlights are: 0 broad and dull, 1 a pin-point like polished metal. Range: 0 to 1. Category: Surface. (float, default 0.5)

emissiveMap.description: What glows in the dark, times emissive. Empty: emissive alone, everywhere. A texture path. Category: Surface. (AssetPath)

emissive.description: Linear RGB light the surface gives off, unlit and unshadowed; 0 0 0 (the default) is none. At least 0. Category: Surface. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

vertexColors.description: Multiply the albedo by the mesh's vertex colours: glTF COLOR_0, white where a model has none. Category: Surface. (bool, default false)

environmentMap.description: A panorama (longitude across, sky at the top) reflected in the surface; needs reflectivity. A texture path. Category: Surface. (AssetPath)

reflectivity.description: How much of environmentMap the surface reflects (times the specular map's red); 0 is none. Range: 0 to 1. Category: Surface. (float, default 0)

weathering.description: How much rain wets it: darker and glossier facing the sky, puddles where flat; 0 stays dry (opaque materials only) Range: 0 to 1. Category: Surface. (float, default 1)
